topic: Carry any balance on a credit card and you lose the interest-free grace period -- new purchases start charging from day one
title: How Credit Cards Charge Interest From Day One
description:
If you carry any credit card balance, you lose the interest-free grace period. New purchases start accruing interest the moment you make them. Here's how that mechanism works and why it's so expensive.

#creditcard #personalfinance #interest #debt #finance
